notes.title: Update March 2020. Coronavirus!
notes.content:
Wanna know what it feels like to have coronavirus without actually getting it?
Here's your chance to see what the whole fuss is about and prevent the spread of the infection in Hell!
This is a free demo version of the game that includes one level and a boss fight. We changed the plot and the dialogues in the demo a little to follow the trend. Oh yeah, one more thing: just chill, bro! Remember it's just a game, so don't take it too seriously! Take care!

notes.title: One Helluva Christmas!!!
notes.content:
One Helluva Christmas
Even in Hell they celebrate Christmas! White Christmases are the best! That's when Lou puts on his Santa hat and goes out to slaughter white people (as well as everyone else), the more the merrier.
Apart from the Christmas mode, we slightly changed the balance and made the game more challenging. We also localized BDSM in Ukrainian. As well as that, there's now an alternative main character you can choose - Afro Lou, who can use the N-word one whole time in dialogues. Enjoy!

notes.title: RELEASED! RELEASED! RELEASED!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31014526/62af5b752bfc4eefef94d3c90db7780950361d2c.jpg[/img]

Hell just got a deadly new diabolic avenger, as BDSM: Big Drunk Satanic Massacre from developer and publisher Big Way Games has arrived on the PC today!

BDSM is a satirical action RPG where you get to play Lou, Satan’s son as he battles a horrific human invasion of Hell. Grab your guns, stock up on milk — and save Hell! While you’re at it, rescue the awesome demoness from the clutches of those nasty people and mega-corporations!

Features of BDSM: Big Drunk Satanic Massacre include:
[list][*] A hilarious story feating Lou, Satan’s son, as he attempts to save Hell! Defeat those meddlesome humans who’ve invaded the fiery pit, and send those mega-corporation stooges back to earth while you’re at it!
[/list][list][*] Explore spectacular locations, destroy everything in them while you battle epic bosses and relentless minion hordes
[/list][list][*] Guns, gore...and milk all take center stage as Lou’s implements of destruction
[/list][list][*] Save the demoness, save the (hell)world — those evil mega-corp fiends have captured your friend so show them what “giving ‘em hell” really means[/list]

About Big Way Games, the developers of this game:
Big Way Games Studio was founded in March 2015 as a collective of several development teams working on a mix of projects. Spread out across multiple territories, the Big Way team shares a common goal — to make the most unique games possible.

notes.title: Woohoo! New gameplay trailer released!
notes.content:
In the previously released trailer for the upcoming action-RPG, BDSM: Big Drunk Satanic Massacre, you met Lou, the son of Satan and the main character in the game. You might say Lou’s an action aficionado, and in today’s new trailer, he’s showing you some of the hottest hellfire-infused run-and-gun fun available in the underworld! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31014526/4bd95147ea477620035b463808a790b8c97ae599.png[/img]

Check out the new video, and get a guided tour of the Inferno itself — complete with magic milk (it’s good for what ails ya’), mega-bosses, and mindless minions. Did we fail to mention that Hell’s been taken over by an evil human corporation that’s grinding up poor helpless demons and serving up the meat to hapless humans?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AEY_RFY2MOU

Yeah, so that’s happening. It’s your job, as Lou, to put a stop to it with your guns, gear, and Satanic satire. If you enjoy an old-fashioned action-packed isometric dungeon crawl where it’s good to be bad, and better to be badder, hop on the BDSM train now, it’s a helluva time for all ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Locations of the game
notes.content:
[h1][b]Strip club “Purple Rapture”[/b][/h1]
Almost immediately after the seizure, people began to open strip clubs and brothels throughout hell. Profits grew, many were ready to pay a huge amount per night or at least an hour with a charming succubus. “Purple Rapture” is famous for being one of the largest and oldest establishments of its kind.

notes.title: Сharacters of the game
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31014526/375c05ac97d22204ee5f1848074e1227e45a7f53.png[/img][h1][b]Behemoth Boss[/b][/h1]

Behemoth is the demon of gluttony. He used to enjoy listening to the cries of tormented sinners who overate in their lifetime. But then he learned about Big Wac, the largest fast food restaurant chain, applied for a job there and began his own career. Now that he's been promoted to kitchen manager, he's become Big Wac's right-hand demon. An obese, friendly manager, dressed to the nines. Wears a starched shirt, a badge and a handlebar mustache. What you don't see behind this is an evil demon using hot sauce as fuel for a jet of fire spurting out of his stomach. Too fat to see his own balls.
